I germinated my latest seeds in peat moss and perlite and will grow them in it till they need repotting. As peat moss has no nutritional vale, should I start giving the plants a very diluted feed early on? How long can they survive in such a medium with no feeding? They ar eonly just getting their true leaves and dont look too bad yet.
Growing in peat moss, should I feed earlier than normal?

Well, if they are just now getting their first true leaves, you are ok for a little while. You want to start feeding at around 3 nodes. If the plant looks like she needs it before that, obviously feed, but for me it's usually two weeks of just water at the beginning. If you don't know the strain that well as far as nute requirements and such, it's always better to start off light, 1/2 or even 1/4 strength nutes. Better to give them a little bit less than to give them to much and burn them.
